# Results: sparkov (generated by the training script)

Data: Sparkov simulated card transactions (Kaggle, CC0), 1,852,394 rows, 999 cards, 693 merchants. SIMULATED data, not real customers. Official split is temporal (test file is later); the last 20% of the train file by time is validation.
Behavioural features use only the past of each card; merchant/category risk uses labels at least 7 days old.
Frauds in train/val/test: 5968/1538/2145.
Champion chosen on **validation** PR-AUC: `hgb_behaviour`. Test is used only for the numbers below.

`test_pr_auc_lo/hi` is a 95% stratified-bootstrap interval (100 resamples); with 2145 test frauds,
differences smaller than the interval are not evidence.

## Cost-optimal threshold (fitted on validation, applied to test)
Assumption: one manual review costs `review_cost_usd`; a missed fraud costs its amount.
| review_cost_usd | threshold | precision | recall | f1 | alerts | cost_model | cost_flag_nothing | cost_flag_everything | saving_vs_nothing_pct |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.0000 | 0.0037 | 0.1821 | 0.9772 | 0.3071 | 11507.0000 | 17590.1401 | 1133324.6250 | 555719.0000 | 98.4479 |
| 5.0000 | 0.0163 | 0.3774 | 0.9506 | 0.5403 | 5403.0000 | 47389.2695 | 1133324.6250 | 2778595.0000 | 95.8186 |
| 20.0000 | 0.0490 | 0.5437 | 0.9166 | 0.6825 | 3616.0000 | 113939.5469 | 1133324.6250 | 11114380.0000 | 89.9464 |

F1-optimal threshold from validation, applied to test: precision 0.868, recall 0.784, F1 0.824.
